## Marrowline repair

### ↻ attachment fidelity
- keeps the exact file/photo payload for the current live Red Deer turn in non-enumerable browser memory
- ↻ resends those exact attachments with the original prompt after the visible staging tray clears
- durable IndexedDB/localStorage records continue to keep receipt metadata rather than raw attachment bodies
- if an older/reloaded saved turn has attachment receipt metadata but its raw bytes are no longer present, retry holds for explicit reattachment rather than silently sending text-only

### ⌕ saved-conversation search
- adds a compact ⌕ control to the saved-conversations popout
- expands a small local search field
- filters saved conversations across titles, Red Deer inputs, and Kʰonapolit outputs
- whitespace-separated terms use conjunctive matching after Unicode NFKC/case normalization
- preserves existing activity ordering, rename/delete behavior, and consumes zero provider calls

### Regression coverage
- file + photo exact-payload replay through the independent ↻ gesture
- raw replay bytes never enter durable thread JSON
- Red Deer/Kʰonapolit keyword matching
- local drawer filtering with no extra provider request

Base: main @ 5b4b34278c6100d3c21ced35984c046da157e097
⟐
